plugins.name: retrospect
plugins.description: Retrospective over your past Claude Code sessions — parallel subagents mine each transcript for your corrections, recurring failure patterns, workflow friction, and wins, then reconcile everything into a report plus approved CLAUDE.md updates — or hunt one specific recurring instruction across your history with a topic argument — in this project, another project, or all of them. One skill, one agent, read-only until you approve.

plugins.name: codex-exec
